context_varying_parameters.name: sex_probability_f
context_varying_parameters.reason: Specified source sex; an explicit equal-code target composition scenario. Source biological labels are an internal encoding and target label transfer remains assumed.

context_varying_parameters.name: anchor_plan
context_varying_parameters.reason: Source contexts select their own reported marginal anchors. Target chooses an equal-weight interpolation within each source code, without treating site as target lifestyle or using sample sizes as weights.

context_varying_parameters.name: lipid_log_location_shift
context_varying_parameters.reason: A zero net log-assay offset is the declared baseline measurement scenario; shared units do not verify this offset or assay equivalence.

context_varying_parameters.name: additional_measurement_log_sd
context_varying_parameters.reason: Source zero avoids adding error twice to measured marginals; the target receives explicit assumed extra multiplicative assay scatter (TC 0.06, HDL 0.08). These magnitudes are unvalidated.
